notes: Self-contained variant of Projectpart1.sas for one-line /v1/quick demos: the player_data set is built with an inline DATALINES DATA step instead of PROC IMPORT, so the script runs with no external CSV. The PRINT/MEANS/FREQ/CORR/SGPLOT analysis and the same column set (games goals xG assists shots key_passes yellow_cards red_cards, plus position/team_title) are unchanged from the author's original.
